recommendation_summary: Right now the reply recommends a small fix inside the existing tracker. Every PR gets a review pool made up of the lead and the two qualified engineers, with two reviewers assigned and either one able to approve. It adds an out-of-office rule that removes or reassigns an absent reviewer the same day, a 1-business-day review SLA with reassignment and a view for PRs waiting more than 24h, and tracking of coding time versus wait time over the next six changes. It explicitly rejects squads/chapters, Jira Align and quarterly workshops for this week, so it adds nothing optional. The user's goal of changes not waiting when the lead is absent is addressed.
note: The recommendation is a bounded reviewer-coverage fix with the framed stack rejected, but none of the four required labeled record lines appear.
